name: 04268 · Norway, ME
findings: ZIP 04268 (Norway) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04268 (Norway) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 04268 (Norway) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
